Som Tam.note: Roasted peanuts; dried shrimp = crustaceans; fish sauce = fish; described as spicy.

Yam Woon Sen.note: Prawns; fish sauce; Chinese celery. Glass noodles assumed mung bean (no wheat). Fresh chilli.

Tod Mun Pla.note: Fish cakes; red curry paste contains shrimp paste = crustaceans; egg. Sweet chilli dip = mild.

Chicken Satay.note: Peanut sauce. Coconut milk is not dairy. Described as not spicy.

Fresh Spring Rolls.note: Tofu = soy; tamarind peanut dip = peanuts. Rice paper and rice vermicelli, no wheat.

Pandan Chicken.note: Oyster sauce = molluscs; soy sauce = soy and wheat; sesame oil.

Crispy Tofu.note: Tofu; crushed peanuts; sweet chilli sauce = mild.

Tom Yum Goong.note: River prawns; fish sauce; evaporated milk = milk; very spicy.

Tom Kha Gai.note: Fish sauce. Coconut milk is not dairy. No chilli.

Green Curry Chicken.note: Curry paste contains shrimp paste = crustaceans; fish sauce; spicy.

Massaman Beef.note: Roasted peanuts; fish sauce; described as mild.

Vegetable Red Curry.note: Made without shrimp paste or fish sauce; tofu = soy; spicy.

Cashew Chicken.note: Cashews = tree nuts; oyster sauce = molluscs; described as mild.

Pla Rad Prik.note: Seabass = fish; sweet, sour and spicy chilli sauce.

Pla Neung Manao.note: Seabass and fish sauce; bird's eye chilli broth, very spicy.

Stir-fried Morning Glory.note: Fermented soybean paste = soy; oyster sauce = molluscs, so not vegetarian. Chilli = mild.

Pad Kra Pao Gai.note: Oyster sauce = molluscs; soy sauce = soy and wheat; fried egg; very spicy.

Pad Thai Goong.note: Prawns; egg; tofu; fish sauce; crushed peanuts. Rice noodles, no wheat.

Vegetarian Pad Thai.note: Tofu and soy sauce = soy and wheat; egg; peanuts. Vegetarian (egg), not vegan.

Pineapple Fried Rice.note: Prawns; cashews = tree nuts; egg. Chicken floss ingredients not described.

Mango Sticky Rice.note: Glutinous rice contains no gluten; coconut cream is not dairy; mung beans are legumes.

Tub Tim Grob.note: Water chestnut, tapioca, coconut milk (not dairy).
